Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning reporting the location of human remains.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to reporting the location of human remains; addinga new section to chapter 68.50 RCW; creating a new section; andprescribing penalties.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: This act may be known and cited as Dylan'slaw.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 68.50 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A person who has actual knowledge of the location of humanremains has a duty to report this information to a law enforcementagency or officer. (2) The duty to notify a law enforcement agency or officer underthis section is met if a person provides or attempts to provide suchnotice by telephone or any other means within a reasonable amount oftime not to exceed three days. (3) Failure to report the location of human remains as required by p. 1 HB 1980subsection (1) of this section is a gross misdemeanor.
